Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <DBXG6.663483$f36.18...@news20.bellglobal.com>, Jason
<no...@here.com> writes
>That's incredible!

Not really. It's an Assamite with the standard Assamite penalty. She's
8 cap so, going by the Jyhad 'formula', she should have roughly nine
points of abilities.

With CEL OBF QUI, she has 6 points of disciplines, aus and for add
another 2 points. The equipping special is good, but not that good.
You're going to use it once, maybe twice, per game.

e.g.

Your hand has jammed completely and you just need a maneuver to save
Fatima, so you cycle the Saturday Night Special onto her. Later on, you
give her the .44 Magnum and move off the SNS to a weenie.

Are you really going to use it three, four or five times?
